subject: a snail with a faceted prism shell
pose: body lifting its head while the shell leans backward
art_direction: 夜行蜗牛背着透明棱镜壳，壳内一束橙光折成三段，深蓝身体与青边光轮廓清楚。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Portray a small night snail with a clear faceted prism instead of a conventional shell. One warm orange light beam bends into three contained segments inside the prism, revealing its geometry without spilling across the frame. The snail body is matte deep blue with short upward feelers and calm tiny eyes. Lift its head slightly while the prism shell leans back, creating a patient curious posture. Use a near-black violet background and a thin cyan rim that separates the body from the dark. Render glass edges and soft body folds with restraint. Keep the complete creature centered inside the circular crop, with no landscape, stars, labels, or decorative sparkles.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
